episodes.synopsis: When challenging an archnemesis to a duel, please make sure they do not mistake it as an invitation to hang out. It’s awkward for everyone involved.
episodes.title: Yet Another Showdown! The Magical Girl Has a Brand New Appearance?!

episodes.synopsis: Mikan realizes something — she recognizes the box that seals Shamiko’s dad. That means the factory ruins on the outskirts of town hold clues about Momo’s sister! Maybe.
episodes.title: Urban Exploration! The Troubled Mikan and the Excited Demon

episodes.synopsis: After hearing that Lilith has been sealed for over 2000 years, Shamiko and Momo come up with a plan to let her borrow Shamiko's body and enjoy a day of freedom.
episodes.title: The Dark Witch Returns! With Steam From Hell!

episodes.synopsis: Shamiko visits a café rumored to be frequented by demons in search of clues about Sakura, but somehow ends up getting a part-time job instead!
episodes.title: A New Species Discovered! The Town Café Is a Demon Lair!

episodes.synopsis: Shamiko learns that Lico and Shirosawa have a connection to Sakura and decides to continue working part-time at the café. However, Momo is vehemently opposed to it!
episodes.title: Raid! The Pink Plan to Retake Shamiko!

episodes.synopsis: When Shamiko finds herself in trouble, the one who saves her is none other than Sakura Chiyoda! Meanwhile, Momo takes a certain action to save Shamiko from her nightmare.
episodes.title: Vow Under the Setting Sun! The Path Forward for Demonkind

episodes.synopsis: Shamiko's summer vacation has turned out far more hectic than intended. She tries to reclaim some peace in her life, but the looming stack of homework casts a dark shadow...
episodes.title: A Short Break!! The Demonic Summer Festival

episodes.synopsis: Shamiko promises to visit the zoo with Momo and Mikan and tries making boxed lunches for them. She’ll need help to make something tasty, so Shamiko visits a certain address.
episodes.title: Sparks Fly?! Light and Dark Go on a Joint Excursion!

episodes.synopsis: Momo is stuck in her darkness form! Without the ability to control her strength, Momo unintentionally destroys whatever she touches.
episodes.title: Pitch-Black Feelings!! Darkness Peach Returns!!

episodes.synopsis: Shamiko can’t use her magic rod right because of a lack of imagination. Special training in Lilith’s sealed space will help her. Maybe.
episodes.title: The Ancestor’s Dojo?! Demonkind’s Ultimate Weapon!

episodes.synopsis: A chaotic summer break ends, and a new school semester begins with Mikan transferring into Shamiko's class.
episodes.title: New Semester! The Magical Girl’s New Duty!

episodes.synopsis: Shamiko and Momo enter Mikan's heart to negotiate with Ugallu, the entity responsible for the magical girl’s curse!
episodes.title: A Ritual in Darkness! The Demon’s New Ally!!
